cohort: 501 pregnant women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
finding: Women with preeclampsia/eclampsia had a higher risk of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including Cesarean section, preterm delivery, prolonged maternal hospitalization, NICU admission, and perinatal mortality, compared to those with chronic or gestational hypertension.
mod_finding: Women with preeclampsia/eclampsia had a significantly higher risk of cesarean section compared to those with chronic/gestational hypertension (adjusted RR 2.139, 95% CI 1.386-3.302, p=0.001).
